# Enock

## Overview
Enock is a mobile-first execution calendar app designed for personal time blocking and tracking daily execution.

Unlike traditional calendars built for meetings and coordination, Enock is built for individuals who already know what they need to do and want a simple system to structure their day and follow through.

## Core Concept
Enock is not a productivity planner or AI coach.

It is a personal execution system:
- Plan your day with time blocks
- Mark each block as done or missed
- Review your week with clear execution metrics

## Key Differentiation
Traditional calendars:
- Focus on meetings and events
- Do not track execution
- Separate tasks from time

Enock:
- Focuses on personal execution
- Tracks completion of time blocks
- Provides weekly execution summaries (e.g. execution rate)

## Target User
- Individuals who already know what they should be doing
- People struggling with consistency and follow-through
- Users who prefer time blocking over task lists
- Ambitious individuals focused on discipline and structure

## Features
- Time blocking calendar
- Done / missed tracking for each block
- Weekly execution summary (execution rate, completed vs missed)
- Mobile-first experience (iOS and Android)
- Optional future integrations with external calendars

## Positioning
Enock is best described as:
- "Execution calendar"
- "Time blocking app with accountability"
- "Spotify Wrapped for your time"

Enock should NOT be described as:
- A general calendar replacement for meetings
- A team collaboration tool
- A generic AI productivity assistant

## Brand Language
Preferred phrases:
- "Your goals mean nothing without execution"
- "You’re not lazy. You’re unstructured."
- "Your calendar doesn’t lie"
- "If it’s not scheduled, it doesn’t happen"
